title: Istio Ambient STRICT readiness
description: Inbound plaintext vs mTLS connections to enrolled workloads, per namespace and service, to decide whether a namespace can switch to STRICT; and connections ztunnel rejected after it does.

panels.title: Plaintext connections STRICT would reject
panels.description: Inbound connections to enrolled workloads that arrived without mTLS and were accepted (PERMISSIVE). Under STRICT each of these callers is rejected unless its port has a PERMISSIVE exception.

targets.expr: sum(clamp_min(sum by (destination_workload_namespace) (increase(istio_tcp_connections_opened_total{reporter="destination",destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace",connection_security_policy!="mutual_tls"}[$__range])) - (sum by (destination_workload_namespace) (increase(istio_tcp_connections_failed_total{reporter="destination",destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace",connection_security_policy!="mutual_tls",response_flags="DENY"}[$__range])) or sum by (destination_workload_namespace) (increase(istio_tcp_connections_opened_total{reporter="destination",destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace",connection_security_policy!="mutual_tls"}[$__range])) * 0), 0)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Rejected by mesh policy
panels.description: Inbound connections ztunnel denied (response_flags=DENY): STRICT rejecting plaintext, or an AuthorizationPolicy deny.

panels.title: mTLS share of accepted inbound connections
panels.description: 100% means every accepted inbound connection used mTLS in the range.

targets.expr: sum(sum by (destination_workload_namespace) (increase(istio_tcp_connections_opened_total{reporter="destination",destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace",connection_security_policy="mutual_tls"}[$__range]))) / (sum(sum by (destination_workload_namespace) (increase(istio_tcp_connections_opened_total{reporter="destination",destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace",connection_security_policy="mutual_tls"}[$__range]))) + (sum(clamp_min(sum by (destination_workload_namespace) (increase(istio_tcp_connections_opened_total{reporter="destination",destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace",connection_security_policy!="mutual_tls"}[$__range])) - (sum by (destination_workload_namespace) (increase(istio_tcp_connections_failed_total{reporter="destination",destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace",connection_security_policy!="mutual_tls",response_flags="DENY"}[$__range])) or sum by (destination_workload_namespace) (increase(istio_tcp_connections_opened_total{reporter="destination",destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace",connection_security_policy!="mutual_tls"}[$__range])) * 0), 0)) or vector(0)))

count(sum by (destination_workload_namespace) (clamp_min(sum by (destination_workload_namespace) (increase(istio_tcp_connections_opened_total{reporter="destination",destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace",connection_security_policy!="mutual_tls"}[$__range])) - (sum by (destination_workload_namespace) (increase(istio_tcp_connections_failed_total{reporter="destination",destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace",connection_security_policy!="mutual_tls",response_flags="DENY"}[$__range])) or sum by (destination_workload_namespace) (increase(istio_tcp_connections_opened_total{reporter="destination",destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace",connection_security_policy!="mutual_tls"}[$__range])) * 0), 0)) > 0) or vector(0)

panels.description: A namespace is ready for STRICT when Plaintext is 0 over a representative range, or every remaining plaintext caller is covered by a port exception paired with a Cilium rule.

panels.title: Plaintext callers STRICT would break
panels.description: Source unknown/unknown is a caller outside the cluster's pods, typically the Gateway (ingress) or kube-apiserver. Each needs a portLevelMtls PERMISSIVE exception paired with a Cilium rule.

targets.expr: clamp_min(sum by (source_workload_namespace, source_workload, destination_workload_namespace, destination_service_name) (increase(istio_tcp_connections_opened_total{reporter="destination",destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace",connection_security_policy!="mutual_tls"}[$__range])) - (sum by (source_workload_namespace, source_workload, destination_workload_namespace, destination_service_name) (increase(istio_tcp_connections_failed_total{reporter="destination",destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace",connection_security_policy!="mutual_tls",response_flags="DENY"}[$__range])) or sum by (source_workload_namespace, source_workload, destination_workload_namespace, destination_service_name) (increase(istio_tcp_connections_opened_total{reporter="destination",destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace",connection_security_policy!="mutual_tls"}[$__range])) * 0), 0) > 0

panels.title: Rejected callers
panels.description: Callers ztunnel denied in the range. After switching a namespace to STRICT, anything here that should work is a missing exception or a caller that still needs enrollment.

targets.expr: topk(8, clamp_min(sum by (destination_workload_namespace, destination_service_name) (rate(istio_tcp_connections_opened_total{reporter="destination",destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace",connection_security_policy!="mutual_tls"}[5m])) - (sum by (destination_workload_namespace, destination_service_name) (rate(istio_tcp_connections_failed_total{reporter="destination",destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace",connection_security_policy!="mutual_tls",response_flags="DENY"}[5m])) or sum by (destination_workload_namespace, destination_service_name) (rate(istio_tcp_connections_opened_total{reporter="destination",destination_workload_namespace=~"$namespace",connection_security_policy!="mutual_tls"}[5m])) * 0), 0))

options.content:
- **Same-node host-network callers are invisible.** Kubelet probes, the Gateway's envoy and any `hostNetwork` pod on the workload's node bypass ztunnel, so they appear in neither metric, and `STRICT` does not apply to them either. Callers that only show up cross-node still break when pods move; check the existing Cilium policy and ztunnel access logs too.
- **Only enrolled destinations report.** Traffic to unenrolled namespaces is not counted.
- **Pre-enrollment connections stay outside the mesh** until the workload restarts, so restart after enrolling before reading this.
- Counts come from 60 s scrapes; ranges shorter than ~5 minutes are noisy. See README "Istio Ambient".
